description: Auth service slowdown caused by an unindexed session query cascades to api-gateway timeouts. Alert fires on api-gateway but root cause is in auth-service.

known_root_cause.description: Auth service deploy adds session activity tracking with a query on the sessions table lacking an index on user_id. Under prod load, query takes 8-12s. api-gateway waits for auth verification on every request, causing cascading timeout. Root cause is in auth-service, not api-gateway.

ground_truth.root_cause_summary: Unindexed session query in deploy-auth-114 causes auth-service p99 to reach 11s, cascading timeouts to api-gateway
